es.title: Cerio
es.extract: El cerio es un mineral y elemento químico de símbolo Ce y número atómico de 58. Es uno de los 14 elementos químicos que siguen al lantano en la tabla periódica, denominados por ello lantánidos. El cerio está situado entre el lantano y el praseodimio.
es.description: elemento de la tabla periódica, con símbolo Ce y número atómico 58

en.title: Cerium
en.extract: Cerium is a chemical element; it has symbol Ce and atomic number 58, and is a soft, ductile, and silvery-white metal that tarnishes when exposed to air. Cerium is the second element in the lanthanide series, and while it often shows the oxidation state of +3 characteristic of the series, it also has a stable +4 state that does not oxidize water. It is considered one of the rare-earth elements. Cerium has no known biological role in humans but is not particularly toxic, except with intense or continued exposure.
